messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-01-22, the product catalog deploy window remains weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team observed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- Farah is release captain for Q3 2025 for the Dune team. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-3]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- The ledger service relies on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]
- Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. [valid 2025-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-22]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-17]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-07-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-09]
- The notifier depends on the bus for delivery events, so it is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- The webhook dispatcher depends on the bus for outbound events, so it is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- As of 2026-04-14, Farah is primary on-call for the Dune team, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-11, Tomasz is primary on-call for the Dune team, having taken over from Farah. [valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah Haddad is primary on-call for the Dune team, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]

    earlier: As of 2025-11-17, Farah still has the Dune team pager. [valid 2025-11-17 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-17]
- The reporting service stopped using the ledger service because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team observes a no-deploy Friday, with no deployments on Fridays. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]

Question: What is the current deploy window for the ledger?

There's no entry about the ledger service's deploy window. There's a billing API deploy freeze, and an Atlas no-deploy Friday, but nothing about the ledger deploy window.
